name: Declaration
description: A formal request made to customs to place goods under a given customs procedure

name: DeclarationGovernment
description: Government-specific declaration processing information and procedures

name: DeclarationGoodShipment
description: Link between a declaration and the goods shipment it covers

name: CustomsDeclarationDocument
description: The physical or electronic customs declaration document

name: Amendment
description: A modification to a previously accepted declaration

name: Cancellation
description: A request to cancel a previously accepted declaration

name: Consignment
description: A separately identifiable collection of goods items transported together

name: ConsignmentItem
description: An individual item within a consignment

name: TransportContractDocument
description: A document evidencing a contract of carriage (B/L, AWB)

name: AssociatedTransportDocument
description: Additional transport documentation linked to the consignment

name: ConsolidatedConsignment
description: Multiple consignments grouped under a single transport contract

name: Commodity
description: A tradeable article or product classified under a tariff nomenclature

name: GoodsItem
description: An individual goods line item in a declaration or consignment

name: GoodsMeasure
description: Quantitative measurements of goods — weight, volume, supplementary units

name: Packaging
description: Details of how goods are packed — type, quantity, marks and numbers

name: DangerousGoods
description: Hazardous materials classification per UN dangerous goods regulations

name: Classification
description: Tariff classification of goods under HS or national nomenclature

name: TariffQuantity
description: Quantity expressed in tariff-specific units for duty calculation

name: AdditionalInformation
description: Supplementary coded or free-text information about the goods

name: PreviousDocument
description: Reference to a prior customs document related to the goods

name: TransportMeans
description: Any vehicle or vessel used to carry goods across borders

name: BorderTransportMeans
description: The active transport means crossing the customs border

name: TransitTransportMeans
description: Transport means used during transit movement

name: ArrivalTransportMeans
description: Transport means on arrival at destination

name: DepartureTransportMeans
description: Transport means at point of departure

name: TransportEquipment
description: Containers, swap bodies, and other transport equipment

name: Seal
description: Physical or electronic seal affixed to transport equipment

name: Itinerary
description: The planned or actual route of transport

name: TransportEvent
description: A significant event during transport — loading, departure, arrival

name: Party
description: Any organization or person involved in international trade

name: Agent
description: A person or company authorized to act on behalf of another party

name: Buyer
description: The party purchasing the goods in a trade transaction

name: Seller
description: The party selling the goods in a trade transaction

name: Consignor
description: The party consigning goods for shipment (shipper)

name: Consignee
description: The party to whom the goods are consigned (receiver)

name: Declarant
description: The party making the customs declaration

name: Carrier
description: The party responsible for the transport of goods

name: CustomsBroker
description: A licensed professional handling customs formalities

name: Importer
description: The party importing goods into a customs territory

name: Exporter
description: The party exporting goods from a customs territory

name: Manufacturer
description: The party that manufactured or produced the goods

name: NotifyParty
description: The party to be notified upon arrival of goods

name: FreightForwarder
description: An intermediary arranging transport and logistics

name: WarehouseKeeper
description: The operator of a customs bonded warehouse

name: Location
description: A geographic place relevant to trade and customs operations

name: Address
description: A structured postal address associated with a location or party

name: LoadingLocation
description: The place where goods are loaded onto transport

name: UnloadingLocation
description: The place where goods are unloaded from transport

name: CustomsOffice
description: A government office where customs formalities are performed

name: EntryPort
description: The first port of arrival in the importing country

name: ExitPort
description: The last port of departure from the exporting country

name: DestinationCountry
description: The final country of destination for the goods

name: CustomsValuation
description: Determination of the customs value of imported goods per WTO rules

name: DutyTaxFee
description: Individual duty, tax, or fee line applied to goods

name: ObligationGuarantee
description: Financial security ensuring payment of customs duties

name: Payment
description: Record of duty/tax payment made to customs

name: AccountingEntry
description: A booking entry in the customs duty accounts

name: ExchangeRate
description: Currency conversion rate applied to value calculations

name: BankAccount
description: Bank account details for payment or refund

name: TradeFinanceDocument
description: Letter of credit, bank guarantee, or other trade finance instrument

name: AdditionalDocument
description: Any supporting document attached to a declaration

name: Certificate
description: An official document certifying a fact (origin, health, conformity)

name: License
description: A government authorization to import/export specific goods

name: Permit
description: A permission document required by regulatory agencies

name: Invoice
description: Commercial invoice detailing the trade transaction

name: PackingList
description: Detailed list of goods and their packaging

name: BillOfLading
description: Transport document for sea freight

name: AirWaybill
description: Transport document for air cargo

name: InsuranceDocument
description: Cargo insurance certificate or policy

name: HarmonizedSystem
description: The WCO Harmonized System commodity classification (HS)

name: NationalTariffLine
description: Country-specific tariff line extending HS to 8+ digits

name: PreferenceCode
description: Code indicating preferential tariff treatment under FTA/GSP

name: QuotaAllocation
description: Allocation of import quota quantities for restricted goods

name: Restriction
description: Trade restriction or prohibition applicable to the goods

name: RiskAssessment
description: Automated or manual risk evaluation of a declaration

name: ExaminationNotice
description: Notification that goods have been selected for examination

name: ExaminationResult
description: Outcome of a physical or documentary examination

name: GovernmentProcedure
description: A customs procedure code (CPC) governing the goods movement

name: Selectivity
description: Criteria and rules for automated risk-based channel assignment

name: CertificateOfOrigin
description: Document certifying the country of origin of goods

name: PreferentialTreatment
description: Application of reduced duty rates under trade agreements

name: RulesOfOrigin
description: Criteria determining whether goods qualify for preferential origin

name: OriginDeclaration
description: Self-certification of origin by the exporter

name: RegionalValueContent
description: Calculation of regional value for origin determination

name: CumulationRule
description: Rules allowing materials from partner countries to count as originating

name: Warehouse
description: A customs-approved storage facility for goods under customs control

name: CustomsBondedArea
description: A designated area where goods are stored under bond

name: FreeZone
description: A designated area with special customs and tax treatment

name: TemporaryStorage
description: Short-term storage of goods pending customs clearance

name: InwardProcessing
description: Import of goods for processing and re-export

name: OutwardProcessing
description: Export of goods for processing and re-import

name: ECommerceItem
description: A goods item sold through an online platform or marketplace

name: DeMinimisDeclaration
description: Simplified declaration for low-value e-commerce shipments

name: SimplifiedDeclaration
description: Reduced data requirement declaration for trusted traders

name: ReturnGoods
description: Declaration for return of previously exported e-commerce goods

name: PostalItem
description: Goods shipped via postal service subject to customs clearance

name: CourierShipment
description: Express courier shipments with expedited customs clearance

name: Response
description: A formal reply from customs to a submitted declaration or request

name: DecisionNotification
description: Notification of a customs decision (acceptance, rejection, query)

name: ReleaseNotification
description: Authorization to release goods from customs control

name: QueryNotification
description: A request from customs for additional information

name: ErrorNotification
description: Notification of errors found in a submitted declaration

name: PenaltyAssessment
description: Assessment of fines or penalties for customs violations
